correctness.rationale: Exact binary state transition follows from degree maxima and positive leading coefficients; a ten-state rational generating-function certificate is checked by twenty polynomial identities. Its formal-series solution proves both infinite exact counts; coefficient recurrence and odd-monic superset prove the unrestricted reciprocal O(X^theta) bound. Polynomial enumeration through 32768 is independent finite corroboration.
